title: PDAC Synthetic Gene-Circuit Design Pipeline
ruo_banner: RESEARCH USE ONLY — not for clinical or diagnostic use

module_I.name: target-prioritization
module_I.criterion_note: Headline gate = permutation enrichment of the known-driver set (multiple-testing-free). recovery_margin is a floor (>=2 master drivers in top-K); the control set deliberately mixes bulk-detectable lineage TFs (GATA6/KLF5/HNF1A/FOXA2) with subset/context-specific ones (ZEB1 mesenchymal, MYC pan-expressed, TP63 basal-only) that are not expected to top a tumor-intrinsic ranking.

module_VII.name: denovo-part-generation
module_VII.criterion_note: GAN (WGAN-GP) is certified-real iff (a) generated promoters match real 4-mer composition better than random DNA (JS <= realism_js_max AND lower than random) AND (b) the library contains a STRONG SELECTABLE TAIL: 90th-percentile predicted promoter strength >= strength_p90_min (this is how the pipeline uses it — it selects the strongest generated promoter). Median strength uplift over random is reported honestly but NOT gated: a faithful generator reproduces the full (weak-heavy) real promoter distribution, so its MEDIAN is near random; the value is realistic composition + a strong tail. Generated sequences are GENERATED CANDIDATES, never passed off as real data.
